title: The Hermit's Horn
summary: Gus wants a shard of the Stonehorn's horn. Climb the crags and kill the ram.
ask: Gus: You climb? Good. I don't anymore. Knees.
Gus: There's a ram up there with horns of solid rock. Bring me a piece and I'll make you something worth the bruises.

done: Hoofprints pressed an inch into bare stone. Something heavy walks here.

start: The mountain stamps. Stones skitter past you. The Stonehorn lowers its head.
done: It falls like a landslide. A shard of horn rolls to your feet.
Gus: Ha. Still warm. Give me a minute.
Gus: There. Blow it and every herd in earshot runs where you point. Once a day, mind. The mountain gets tired of noise.
